summary: Diversity rework: add hard max_per_tradition output cap (default 3, matching pipeline) plus rarity-aware boost computed in a first pass over all merged chunks, replacing the order-dependent in-map binary boost

analysis.author: Backend Engineer
analysis.content: Scope narrowed: the max_per_tradition cap is being pulled into fbf4652f as part of the faithful canonical port (it's one function in guru/retriever.py). faedd67a's remaining work is just replacing the canonical first-seen +0.1 diversity boost with a rarity-aware two-pass boost (count traditions across all merged chunks first, then weight rarer traditions higher), which is the part that goes BEYOND canonical and fully closes ce844add.

resolution.note: Replaced canonical first-seen +0.1 boost with a two-pass rarity-weighted boost: count traditions across the merged set, then diversity = DIVERSITY_BOOST / count. Order-independent; rewards rare traditions (the [Plotinus*6, Vedanta, Sufi] case). Harness unchanged at the aggregate (cap already maxes coverage: 6.17 traditions, 0/12 below target) — the win is correctness/order-independence, pinned by d1a94167.
